name: agent-swarm help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:agent-swarm. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Save preset
entries.text: Saves this mix of agents and models so you can pick it again.

entries.title: Run
entries.text: Starts it now. Part of Agent swarm.

entries.title: Preview brief
entries.text: Previews brief. Part of Agent swarm.

entries.title: Page or site URL
entries.text: The web page this employee learns from. Its text is stored as their knowledge and goes into their job briefs.

entries.title: Crawl
entries.text: How many more pages on the same site to fetch after this one (up to 20).

entries.title: Train
entries.text: Fetches the page (and the crawl) and adds it to this employee's knowledge.

entries.title: Remove all
entries.text: Deletes every page this employee was trained on.

entries.title: Approve
entries.text: Hires a new builder (name, avatar, persona, voice, builder tools) and gives them the waiting build. Only your own click counts.

entries.title: Deny
entries.text: Closes the hire request without hiring anyone.
